trigger.failure: UNIQUE(source_id, link_pagina) rejected second distinct observed external ID on same actual URL
trigger.canonical_resolver: already separated source/external IDs; no change to canonical.py/publication.py needed

schema.known: unique(source_id,external_id) WHERE external_id IS NOT NULL AND trim(external_id) <> empty
schema.legacy: unique(source_id,link_pagina) WHERE external_id IS NULL OR trim(external_id) = empty

migration.upgrade_conflicts: abort on duplicate source/external IDs or duplicate legacy source/URLs; no merge
migration.downgrade_conflicts: abort if any source/URL pair repeats; no deletion or invented URL
migration.sqlite: transactional table rebuild preserves values, IDs, auxiliary indexes, triggers and child references; foreign_key_check before commit
migration.postgresql: transaction and ACCESS EXCLUSIVE table lock

collector_guards: contradictory known IDs cannot merge by URL
missing incoming ID cannot erase existing reviewed ID
